tool_activity.description: Display-only tool lifecycle event. Arguments and raw output excluded. Optional Core-approved display target and summary. Live/replay only; not conversation/model history.

tool_name.description: Trusted display catalog label, not a model-provided tool identifier.

target.description: Optional Core-approved display target. Never inferred from raw arguments by clients.

summary.description: Optional sanitized display summary explicitly supplied by Core, never raw tool output.
